Finding what CRAN asks to fix

Source: R/package_tools.R
find_cran.Rd

These functions find problems that R CMD check --as-cran reports and that CRAN asks to be fixed before it accepts a package:

  • find_undocumented_values() lists the help files of a package that have no \value{} section. CRAN asks for every help file of a function to say what the function returns. Help files for data and for the package itself are left out.

  • find_nonascii() looks through the datasets of a package for character variables or node attributes that contain characters that are not ASCII. CRAN asks for the data in a package to be ASCII, or to declare an encoding.

Usage

find_undocumented_values(package = NULL)

find_nonascii(pkg)

Arguments

package

The path to the root of a package, or the name of an installed package. By default NULL, which uses the working directory.

pkg

The name of an installed package.

Value

find_undocumented_values() returns a character vector of the names of the help files that have no \value{} section.

find_nonascii() returns a character vector of the datasets and variables, in the form "dataset$variable", that contain non-ASCII characters, invisibly. Each is also printed.

Examples

find_undocumented_values("manypkgs")
#> character(0)
find_nonascii("datasets")
